name: reviewed-document-party-source-v53
sql: DROP VIEW IF EXISTS current_document_party_links; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS document_party_link_events_no_update; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS document_party_link_events_no_delete; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS document_party_link_events_document; ALTER TABLE document_party_link_events RENAME TO document_party_link_events_v52; CREATE TABLE document_party_link_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id),party_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(party_id) BETWEEN 3 AND 64),party_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(party_role IN ('issuer','supplier','customer','recipient','payer','payee','processor','acquirer','related_company','establishment','location','payment_descriptor','vendor','owner','adviser','employee','authority','bank')),event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('linked','superseded')),evidence_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_kind IN ('exact_identifier','reviewed_legacy_reference','reviewed_source_observation')),evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json)),document_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_sha256)=64),document_payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_payload_sha256)=64),party_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(party_snapshot_json)),plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),idempotency_key TEXT,reason TEXT,actor TEXT NOT NULL,principal TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(document_id,party_role,event_type,plan_hash),UNIQUE(idempotency_key)); INSERT INTO document_party_link_events SELECT * FROM document_party_link_events_v52; DROP TABLE document_party_link_events_v52; CREATE VIEW current_document_party_links AS SELECT e.* FROM document_party_link_events e WHERE e.event_type='linked' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_party_link_events s WHERE s.event_type='superseded' AND s.document_id=e.document_id AND s.party_role=e.party_role AND s.plan_hash=e.plan_hash); CREATE INDEX document_party_link_events_document ON document_party_link_events(document_id,party_role,id); CREATE TRIGGER document_party_link_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON document_party_link_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'document party link events are append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER document_party_link_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON document_party_link_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'document party link events are append-only'); END;
